openQuestions: Official name in English and Ukrainian, canonical domain and postal address, from the official site and the EDEBO register.
Dated official statement for the current academic year on whether, where and how foreign students are taught.
State registration (EDEBO), programme licence (Ministry or EDEBO licence register) and NAQA accreditation for each health programme: three separate claims.
Which medicine, dentistry, pharmacy or nursing programmes admit foreign applicants, in which language, with what duration and intake, and the official fee page.
Location lead as found (unverified): Lviv (address lead: vul. P. Doroshenka 70, Lviv — osvita.ua guide, undated)

Relocation lead (unverified): No relocation lead. Admission listings for 2020, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026 on vstup.osvita.ua all place the academy in Lviv (region r14); address lead vul. P. Doroshenka 70, Lviv (osvita.ua). Lviv is not occupied territory. 2024 listing lead: "122 offers, a licensed capacity of 841 places, and 909 total applications"; an older guide entry gives "Ліцензійний обсяг: 582 місць" at 107 offers — figures differ by year and must not be quoted as current.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Name confusion: searches for "Lviv Medical Academy" return Danylo Halytsky Lviv National Medical University (meduniv.lviv.ua, already listed) pages, including its English Medium Program "implemented in 1997" — that programme belongs to LNMU, not to this academy. Any copy must not attribute LNMU's medicine/dentistry/English-medium offers to the academy.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No lead for any 222 Medicine or 221 Dentistry degree programme; the portfolio found is nursing (bachelor/master), pharmacy (master, non-budget), psychology (bachelor) plus vocational nursing/pharmacy. A targeted search for Технології медичної діагностики, Фізична терапія and Стоматологія returned nothing. Relevance to international medicine/dentistry applicants is unsupported; inventory group G (nursing/allied-health level) stands.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: The academy runs an internal "фаховий коледж" offering фаховий молодший бакалавр programmes (Сестринська справа, Акушерська справа, Фармація). These are vocational, not higher-education degrees, and must not be presented as degree programmes.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No lead at all for admission of foreign applicants, English-medium teaching, tuition for foreigners or an international office page; the vstup.osvita.ua directory "doesn't break out foreign applicants". Studyportals/uni2study/unipage are recruitment-style directories and their "scholarships" listings are third-party and possibly stale.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Predecessor identity: unipage.net lists "Andrey Krupynski Lviv Institute of Nursing and Laboratory Medicine"; uni2study says academy status was granted in 2019 and traces lineage to a 1773 "Lviv Medical Collegium". The rename history and the official order are unconfirmed; older directory entries may exist under the institute name.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Inconsistent admission basis for the Pharmacy master's across two search summaries (на базі фахового молодшого бакалавра vs. на базі бакалавра) — do not state either as fact.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Licensed-capacity figures differ across years (582 places/107 offers in an undated guide; 841 places/122 offers in the 2024 listing); none is a verified current figure.
Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No EDEBO or NAQA record surfaced; licence and accreditation status of every programme is unverified.

Missing evidence: Full higher-education programme list (e.g., 224 lab diagnostics, 227 physical therapy): not found; only nursing, pharmacy and psychology leads.

The academy also runs a фаховий коледж whose nursing/pharmacy/midwifery programmes are vocational and must not be shown as degrees.

Skeptic's note: No EDEBO or NAQA record surfaced; licence and accreditation of every programme unverified. Study in Ukraine portal institution page not confirmed (only a programmes-area listing lead).
Skeptic's note: Pharmacy master's admission basis is reported inconsistently (на базі фахового молодшого бакалавра vs на базі бакалавра).
